subject.title: Dashboard: approvals-queue widget (deliver #72545 as a dashboard builtin)

question: Should OpenClaw keep this as a bundled dashboard builtin target once the modular dashboard stack is accepted, or fold it back into the broader Web GUI approvals issue?
rationale: The issue is a new product surface for security-sensitive approval actions and depends on an unmerged dashboard architecture; automation cannot choose the permanent bundled-dashboard direction for maintainers.

options.title: Keep As Dashboard Builtin
options.body: Keep this issue open as the specific approvals-queue widget task, gated on the dashboard stack and security review.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Approvals Issue
options.body: Close or supersede this task into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72545 if maintainers want one canonical Web approvals surface instead of dashboard subissues.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Direction
options.body: Leave the broader dashboard roadmap paused until the Wave 1 stack is corrected and maintainers decide whether default bundled dashboards belong in core.

recommendation.title: Keep As Dashboard Builtin
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the specific approvals-queue widget task, gated on the dashboard stack and security review.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main approval UI/product routing signal and is listed as the project owner in CONTRIBUTING.md.
